Trigger: Demographic parity ratio drops below 0.80 for any measurable group
Interview conversion rate declines >15% from baseline for two consecutive quarters
Rationale: Model may no longer be matching candidates effectively to roles

Trigger: NorthStar's candidate population changes significantly (e.g., entry into new geographies, new role types)
Rationale: Model trained on existing patterns may not generalise

Trigger: HireFlow releases a new model version
Rationale: Material change requires NorthStar validation before acceptance

Trigger: 24 months since last full revalidation (if no other trigger)
